## Antigravity Desktop App on Computer (NOT Antigravity on the Web) — R1 Profile & Board Kit Probe

> **Important scope note:** This report is for the **Antigravity desktop app on computer** (and **not** Antigravity on the web).
> **Key architectural finding:** Launching a project/cloud-agent session from the Antigravity desktop app (`jetski_remote_agents_3p_devbox`) still provisions the **exact same isolated remote Linux VM (`devbox`)** as Antigravity on the web—it does **not** run on the owner's local computer filesystem or reach `127.0.0.1:8765` on the host. Consequently, its capabilities match `antigravity-web` ("in between" Claude Code CLI and Claude Code on the web), with one extra verified capability: **direct outbound HTTPS Option A write-back** to the board's Tailscale Funnel share endpoint (`penguin.tail53fb79.ts.net`) works even without `anlonlt/board` attached. *(If the Antigravity desktop app is run in a purely local-computer workspace mode instead of a `jetski_remote_agents_3p_devbox` remote agent, that local mode would need a separate host-side probe.)*

**Bars:**
- **Board features working:** **9 of 12** tried (6 directly—local `web_takeover.py` server, `kit.py form`, `board_cli.py` comments, `kit.py sub`, Playwright UI checks, and Option A HTTPS share write-back; 3 via workaround—`board-mirror` explicit refspec fetch, `kit.py resume`, and manual memory JIT / save; 3 unavailable—auto hooks/live line, Claude `ArtifactData`, and unattended cron / external session messaging).
- **Minutes from start to first write reaching the board:** **3.7 min** (session start `22:28:03Z` -> Option A POST at `22:31:43Z`).

---

### 1. Reach (verified commands & outputs)
- **Runtime environment (remote devbox, not host computer):**
  - `uname -a` -> `Linux devbox 6.18.57 #1-NixOS SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC x86_64 GNU/Linux` (Ubuntu `24.04.5 LTS`, user `antigravity`, `HOME=/home/antigravity`)
  - `nproc` / `free -m` / `df -h` -> `2` vCPU, `7,959 MB` RAM (`7,497 MB` available), `8,191 MB` swap, `85 GB` free disk; `device.py`: `holds 14 sessions, cores 2, GPUs: none found`
- **Pre-cloned repo & GitHub CLI (`gh`):**
  - Connected repo pre-cloned single-branch at `/home/antigravity/victorcheng28/board` (`fetch = +refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main`).
  - `gh api user --jq '{login: .login}'` -> `{"login":"victorcheng28"}`
  - `gh repo view victorcheng28/board --json nameWithOwner,isPrivate` -> `{"isPrivate":true,"nameWithOwner":"victorcheng28/board"}`
  - `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/anlonlt/board.git /tmp/anlonlt-board` -> exit `0` (public repos readable)
  - Push scope: `git push --dry-run origin HEAD:refs/heads/r1-probe-dryrun` on attached `victorcheng28/board` -> `* [new branch] HEAD -> r1-probe-dryrun` (exit `0`, unrestricted branch push); same command on unattached `anlonlt/board` -> `HTTP 403 Permission denied` (exit `128`).
- **Read `docs/prompts/` & `board-mirror`:**
  - `docs/prompts/` readable directly on both attached repo and cloned `anlonlt/board`.
  - Plain `git fetch origin board-mirror` updates `FETCH_HEAD` only (`fatal: Needed a single revision` on `origin/board-mirror` due to single-branch clone); `git fetch origin +refs/heads/board-mirror:refs/remotes/origin/board-mirror` -> exit `0` (`824cf52` on `victorcheng28/board`, `0466811` on `anlonlt/board`).
- **Toolchain & headless browser:**
  - `python3 --version` -> `Python 3.12.16` (`python3 -I` works)
  - `node --version` -> `v22.23.5`; `docker info` -> `docker: running`; `/usr/bin/google-chrome` & Playwright preinstalled
  - `node kit/board/test_page_layout.js` (on `anlonlt/board`) -> `0 failed` (exit `0`)
- **Network reach:**
  - `curl http://127.0.0.1:8765/health` (before `web_takeover.py`) -> `curl: (7) Couldn't connect to server` (no host local board)
  - `https://example.com` -> HTTP `200`; `https://penguin.tail53fb79.ts.net/_share/...` (Tailscale Funnel share URL) -> HTTP `200` (and Option A POST works).

---

### 2. The board (verified against `anlonlt/board` `feat/streamline-doctor-memory`)
| Action | Verdict | Observed behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `python3 -I .kit/kit.py resume --role part --post r1-...` | **another way** | Fails out of the box on single-branch clone (exit `3` `STALE` on `main` without ArtifactData; needs `origin/board-mirror` fetched via explicit refspec on `feat/streamline-doctor-memory`, after which it exits `0`). |
| `python3 -I .kit/web_takeover.py` | **yes** | Starts local `board_server.py` on `127.0.0.1:8765` (persists across tool calls, responds JSON), reconciles `263` items from `origin/board-mirror`. |
| `KIT_SESSION_ID=... python3 -I .kit/kit.py form <post> --doing "..."` | **yes** | Exit `0` (`post: in progress, yours`; creates `.kit/run/form/<post>.md`). |
| Write result to board (`board_cli` / `board-mirror` / Option A) | **another way** | Local `board_cli.py` writes to the VM's `127.0.0.1:8765`, not the owner's host. `web_takeover.py save` refuses push on Artifact-attached repo (`save: not pushed: this board is attached to the Artifact board...`). Works via `sync-db --full --commit` + `git push origin HEAD:board-mirror` (when board repo is attached) **or directly via Option A HTTPS POST** to the share link. |
| Comment (`board_cli.py set comments ... --data ...`) | **yes** | Exit `0` (`{"id": "ag-desktop-probe-001", "version": 1}`) locally; Option A POST writes comments directly to the owner's board. |
| Tick a piece (`python3 -I .kit/kit.py sub <post> 1 --status done`) | **yes** | Exit `0` (`{"post": "r1-...", "done": 5, "of": 5}`). |
| `ArtifactData` / host `127.0.0.1:8765` / clerk messaging | **no** | No Claude `ArtifactData` tool, no host LAN/Tailscale node (`tailscale` absent), no external session messaging. |

---

### 3. The rest of the kit
- **Hooks:** **no.** `.claude/settings.json` hooks never execute (`.kit/run/` did not exist at session start).
- **Live line (`kit_activity.py`):** **no.** Never auto-runs; manual `KIT_POST=... python3 -I .kit/hooks/kit_activity.py` exits `0` locally only and never reaches the owner's board.
- **Usage ledger (`usage.py`):** **no (read-only).** `usage.py --root . self --no-push` prints `usage self: no transcript for CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID here`; no `transcript.jsonl` exists under `/home/antigravity/.gemini/jetski/`. Reading existing rows via `usage.py show` works after fetching `origin/kit-usage`.
- **Memory at edit time (`kit_memory_jit.py`):** **another way (manual only).** No edit hooks fire; manual stdin call works (exit `0`, returned `K3` and `K7` for `kit/board/board.template.html`).
- **Save point (`landing.py save` / `git push`):** **another way (manual only).** No `Stop` / `kit_wip.py` hook runs; manual `landing.py save` (exit `0`) and manual `git commit && git push` persist code cleanly.
- **Takeover by another platform:** **yes (for pushed work / Option A outputs).** Pushed branches on attached repos and Option A board comments/child posts hand off cleanly; unpushed VM files stay trapped in the paused VM.

---

### 4. Limits that matter for routing
- **Compute & session:** 2 vCPU, 8 GB RAM + 8 GB swap, 85 GB disk, no GPU. VM persists across pause/resume; exact turn/quota limits are governed by the Google/Antigravity plan and not readable inside the VM.
- **Background work:** Supports background commands (`WaitMsBeforeAsync`), persistent daemons (`IsDaemon: true`), and parallel in-turn subagents (`invoke_subagent`, shared workspace). **Cannot** wake on unattended cron (`CronCreate`/schedule absent) or receive/send cross-session clerk/orchestrator messages.
- **Files, network, secrets:** Can reach attached GitHub repos (read/write), public HTTPS (including Tailscale Funnel share URLs), `google_search`/`google:browse`, `generate_image`, and uploaded files. **Cannot** reach the user's computer filesystem, host `127.0.0.1:8765`, local secrets/`.env`/keystores, user's logged-in browser, or unattached private repos.
- **Cost:** Uses Google/Antigravity plan quota — **zero Anthropic/Claude tokens and zero local machine CPU/RAM**, though per-session USD cost cannot be auto-logged to `kit-usage`.

---

### 5. Profile & routing verdict (Antigravity desktop app — remote devbox mode)
| Feature | Support | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Clone & read connected GitHub repo + `docs/prompts/` | **yes** | Pre-cloned single-branch; `git` & `gh` work |
| Read `board-mirror` | **another way** | Needs explicit refspec fetch (`+refs/heads/board-mirror:refs/remotes/origin/board-mirror`) |
| Python 3 / Node 22 / full test suites / Docker | **yes** | 2 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, 85 GB disk, Docker daemon running |
| Headless browser / Playwright UI tests | **yes** | Chrome + Playwright preinstalled; `test_page_layout.js` `0 failed` |
| Commit & push arbitrary branches (attached repos) | **yes** | Verified `--dry-run` exit `0` on `victorcheng28/board` |
| Push to unattached repos | **no** | HTTP 403 (`anlonlt/board` not attached) |
| Option A share-link GET & POST (`penguin.tail53fb79.ts.net`) | **yes** | Outbound HTTPS works directly to Tailscale Funnel share endpoint |
| `kit.py resume` / local `board_server` / `form` / `sub` | **another way** | Works locally via `web_takeover.py` + explicit `board-mirror` fetch |
| Write back to owner's board | **another way** | Via Option A share POST or `board-mirror` push (no host `127.0.0.1:8765` or `ArtifactData`) |
| Hooks / live activity line / auto usage ledger | **no** | Zero hooks execute; no `transcript.jsonl` |
| Memory JIT / save point | **another way** | Manual CLI invocation only |
| Takeover by another platform | **yes** | Clean handoff via pushed git branches + board writes |
| In-turn background tasks & subagents | **yes** | `IsDaemon` + `invoke_subagent` (shared workspace) |
| Autonomous cron / clerk / cross-session messaging | **no** | No unattended wake or external `SendMessage` |
| Host computer files / local secrets / GPU / logged-in browser | **no** | Isolated remote cloud VM (`jetski_remote_agents_3p_devbox`) |

**Verdict: In between — identical runtime profile to `antigravity-web` when launched in remote/cloud devbox mode from the Antigravity desktop app.**
- **Best step types:** Self-contained **code** (builds/tests/Docker), **headless browser/Playwright UI tests**, **research** (web + codebase), and **manual code/test review** (especially via Option A share-link write-back or attached repo PRs).
- **Do not route here:** Orchestrator, clerk, tasks needing local host files/secrets/logged-in browser/GPU, or workflows relying on hooks, live activity lines, or `ArtifactData`.
